result.summary: Empirically ran npx drizzle-kit migrate twice against a real scratch Postgres. The idempotency MECHANISM genuinely works (drizzle.__drizzle_migrations row count unchanged on second run, exit 0). But the design's SS3.3 claim that drizzle-kit's own CLI output lists which migration files it applied is factually false -- verified against the real pinned drizzle-kit@0.31.10 binary, both an empty-DB run and a no-op run print the identical '[check] migrations applied successfully!' line, no filenames, no distinguishing 'nothing to apply' message, and no --verbose flag exists to change this. All other checks (AC2/AC3/AC4, no-literal-defaults, open questions, no implementation code) PASS.

issues.description: Design doc SS3.3 claims drizzle-kit migrate's CLI output can demonstrate 'which migrations it applied' -- false, verified against the real binary. Fix: revise SS3.3 to specify querying drizzle.__drizzle_migrations directly (row count / hashes before and after) as the verification method, since no CLI flag lists applied filenames.
